name: Qilin Symlink Evaluation Enabled
description: Detects when remote symbolic-link evaluation is enabled (SymlinkRemoteToRemoteEvaluation or SymlinkRemoteToLocalEvaluation set to 1), which allows the system to follow symbolic links that point to remote machines.
note: Hidden tripwire - no triage here. Triage via the Potential Qilin Staging Activity alert. On its own, this is usually developer symlink tooling.
query:
host.os.type:"windows" and event.category:"registry" and (event.type:"change" or event.type:"creation") and event.code:("12" or "13") and
registry.path:(*Control\\FileSystem\\SymlinkRemoteToRemoteEvaluation or
  *Control\\FileSystem\\SymlinkRemoteToLocalEvaluation) and
registry.data.strings:"1" and registry.data.type:"SZ_DWORD"
